elements.description:
Model routing as a route: rules in order, then the fallback chain, with each target's health, breaker and region,
and a route test the app answers.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the group's name

properties.name: value
properties.description: The rules and the fallback chain. Changed by the user unless tc-value-change is prevented

properties.name: targets
properties.description: Every model or deployment a rule or the chain can name

properties.name: health
properties.description: Each target's health and breaker, by target id, as the app reports them

properties.name: residency
properties.description: The regions requests may be sent to; targets elsewhere are flagged. Empty means no constraint

properties.name: testResult
properties.description: The app's answer to the last route test; setting it ends the pending state

properties.name: testPlaceholder
properties.default: "Describe a request, e.g. 140k-token contract from an EU customer"
properties.description: Placeholder in the route test's field

properties.name: readonly
properties.description: Shows the route without reorder handles or remove buttons

properties.name: path
properties.type: { rules: RoutePathStep[]; fallbacks: RoutePathStep[]; fellBack: boolean } | null
properties.description: Where the last test went: each rule's and each fallback's part in it

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-value-change
events.description: The rules or the fallback chain changed ({ value: ModelRoutingValue }); cancelable – prevent it to control `value`

events.name: tc-route-test
events.description: Test a route was submitted ({ input, value }: RouteTestRequest); answer by setting `testResult`; cancelable – prevented, nothing shows as pending

methods.name: test
methods.description: Runs a route test: the app answers by setting `testResult`

props.name: title
props.description: Shown at the top; names the group

props.name: value
props.description: The rules and the fallback chain (controlled)

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The rules and the chain to start with when uncontrolled

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the whole routing after a reorder, removal or added fallback

props.name: onTest
props.description: Test a route was submitted: work out where `input` goes and pass the answer back as `testResult`
